title: Fix broken word wrap in x509 appendix Interop Notes
description: Pre-existing defect in spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md §9 (present in HEAD f579d84667, surfaced by ksr9 codereview pass 1): line ~209 has a broken word wrap — 'can issue this profile without LICHEN\n -specific software' renders as 'LICHEN -specific software'.
